ul.li: The resolution must be signed by all authorized individuals (all shareholders).
The wording of the resolution clauses must not be altered under any circumstances.
The resolution must be typed on the official company letterhead.
Where multiple Directors or Managers are involved, only additional rows may be inserted.
All names, passport numbers, and nationalities must exactly match the official documents.
If the resolution continues onto a second page, it must also be printed on the company letterhead.
The final document must be fully completed, printed, and stamped using accepted methods.
